lauren: Quick ask  can we add a tiny, runnable Optimize example that shows SDK -> batching -> KV cache -> quant profile in one place? target: copy-pasteable into CI.

mike: I can do a short Python snippet (15-20 lines). Will mock network calls in the test.

anjali: I'll run a quick seq-length sweep (32 vs 256) on rw-opt-quant-8b and paste a compact before/after latency + token-cost table.

sam: Found a stale link in /optimize/batching to the old qprofile doc. I will patch it in the PR and add a redirect note.

jessica: PR checklist: examples/optimize/mini-eval.py, examples/tests/test_mini_eval.py (mocked), update nav, add 2 short recommendation bullets, and a 1-line migration note for legacy batch_* keys.

mike: Draft snippet (will push to branch docs/mini-eval-snippet):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
# int8 for throughput; fp16 when quality matters
q = {"preferred_dtype": "int8"}
resp = c.generate(
  model="rw-opt-quant-8b",
  input="Summarize in 2 bullets:\n- long user query\n",
  batch_options={"max_batch_latency_ms": 25, "max_batch_size": 6},
  cache={"kv_prefetch": True},
  quant_profile=q
)
print(resp.text)
```
